profile.address: Middle-section of Nan'er Huan Road, Xi'an, Shaanxi 710064, China
profile.description: Chang'an University (CHU) is a national key university directly under China's Ministry of Education, listed under Project 211 and Double First-Class. Located in Xi'an with two campuses covering 250 hectares, it has 25 schools spanning 11 disciplines with strengths in highway transportation, civil engineering and earth sciences.
profile.motto: Hongyi Mingde, Duxue Chuangxin (Broad vision, Bright virtue, Diligent learning, Innovation)
profile.tagline: Paving China's highways from ancient Xi'an to the world.

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition, accommodation and insurance waived; stipend RMB 2500/month bachelor, RMB 3000/month master, RMB 3500/month PhD
documents: Study plan and research proposal (500+ words)
scholarships.duration: 4 years bachelor / 3 years master / 4 years PhD
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health with required prior degree and under age limits (25 bachelor, 35 master, 40 PhD). Must meet HSK/English requirements and CSC academic standards.
scholarships.instructions: Apply on the CSC system (Agency No. 10710, Type B) and on the Chang'an online system at is.chd.edu.cn, pay RMB 600 application fee and upload all materials.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship (Type B University Program) at Chang'an University

scholarships.amount_text: PhD/Master: full tuition covered; Bachelor: 50% tuition; plus first-year stipend RMB 1500-2500/month x10 months
documents: Physical examination form and non-criminal record
scholarships.duration: Up to 4 years with annual review (stipend first year only)
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens under 25 bachelor, 35 master, 40 PhD with good records. Must not hold other Chinese government scholarships and meet language requirements.
scholarships.instructions: Select the Belt and Road Scholarship on is.chd.edu.cn, submit materials online and pay RMB 400 fee after preliminary review.
scholarships.title: Xi'an Municipal The Belt and Road Scholarship at Chang'an University

scholarships.amount_text: Hostel fee covered (Weishui campus) plus first-year stipend RMB 1500/month bachelor, RMB 2000/month master, RMB 2500/month PhD
documents: Valid passport and residence permit if in China
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding non-Chinese applicants for bachelor, master, PhD or non-degree study with strong academics and conduct. Age limits 25/35/40/45 by level.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via is.chd.edu.cn for the Presidential Scholarship, upload documents and track email/system for review results.
scholarships.title: Chang'an University Presidential Scholarship

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition, accommodation, insurance, medical exam and residence permit covered plus RMB 1500/month x12 months
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese bachelor applicants under 25 from eligible countries with high-school diploma, good health and HSK 4 180+ or IELTS 6.0/TOEFL 80+.
scholarships.instructions: Apply on is.chd.edu.cn for the Five Central Asian Scholarship before March 31, submit CSCA scores by May 31 and complete online review.
scholarships.title: Xi'an Five Central Asian Countries Scholarship at Chang'an University
